chika_builder.command.desc: Chika Builder builds the named schematic automatically. Movement, pathing and block placement are handled for you; the schematic's corner is placed at your feet.
chika_builder.settings.desc: Creative and auto-shop settings for Chika Builder. Both are off by default. Creative only takes effect when you are actually in Creative; it never changes your gamemode. Auto-shop only spends money when you enable it.
chika_builder.settings.title: Chika Builder
